build_frontend_jar: build the TorchServe frontend by running gradlew to assemble the server JAR file
build_plugins: build TorchServe plugins using the gradlew command with the endpoints plugin option
get_nightly_version: get the current date formatted as YYYY.MM.DD for nightly release versioning
detect_model_server_version: detect the model server version from ts.version.py with optional release or beta suffix
setup_torchserve_package: setup the torchserve package with dependencies, entry points, and custom build commands
